Abbosbek Fayzullaev.note: Fayzullaev's edge is creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him.
Abbosbek Fayzullaev.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在防线重组前制造干净射门。他会主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。

Abdukodir Khusanov.note: Khusanov's signature is recovery speed when the defensive line is exposed. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Abdukodir Khusanov.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在防线暴露后的回追速度上。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Abdulla Abdullaev.note: Abdullaev is defined by making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He positions himself for the next touch before the first contest is over. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Abdulla Abdullaev.noteZh: 他靠在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择与同位置球员拉开差异。他会第一次争抢还没结束，就先为下一脚触球站好位置。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Abduvohid Nematov.note: Watch Nematov for organizing teammates before danger becomes obvious. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Abduvohid Nematov.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在危险出现前组织好队友。留意他如何在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Akmal Mozgovoy.note: Mozgovoy's signature is seeing the decisive pass one beat before it opens. He holds the passing lane into midfield until support arrives. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Akmal Mozgovoy.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在比防线早一步看到决定性的传球上。他会守住通向中场核心区域的传球线路，直到队友能对持球人施压。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Avazbek Ulmasaliyev.note: Ulmasaliyev's signature is pressing with a clear target rather than simply chasing. He turns early and protects the route toward goal. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Avazbek Ulmasaliyev.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在带着明确目标逼抢，而不是只追着球跑上。他会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Azizbek Amonov.note: Watch Amonov for creating a better angle for the next pass. He draws the first challenge, then carries through the gap. He plays through nearby pressure instead of around it.
Azizbek Amonov.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是为下一脚传球制造更好的角度。留意他如何主动吸引第一次上抢，再带球穿过由此出现的空当。他也会穿过最近一层逼抢，而不总是绕开压力。

Azizjon Ganiev.note: Ganiev's edge is moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Azizjon Ganiev.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。他会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Behruzjon Karimov.note: Karimov stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He protects the route to goal and challenges only when the touch is loose.
Behruzjon Karimov.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会先封住通向球门的路线，再等待对手触球失误时上抢。

Botirali Ergashev.note: Ergashev is defined by staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He judges when to leave his line and takes pressure off his defenders.
Botirali Ergashev.noteZh: 他靠在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注与同位置球员拉开差异。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会判断何时出击，替后卫化解高球压力。

Dostonbek Khamdamov.note: Watch Khamdamov for starting his run while defenders are still watching the ball. He protects the ball with his body and returns it into a runner's path. He adjusts his position early enough to make the difficult action look simple.
Dostonbek Khamdamov.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防守者仍盯着球时提前启动。留意他如何用身体护住球，再把球送回跑动队友的线路。他也会提前调整位置，让困难处理看起来简单。

Eldor Shomurodov.note: Watch Shomurodov for creating a clean shot before the defense can reset. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Eldor Shomurodov.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在防线重组前制造干净射门。留意他如何牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Farrukh Sayfiev.note: Sayfiyev is defined by calm decisions shaped by experience in high-pressure moments. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He holds the route into the box until support arrives.
Farrukh Sayfiev.noteZh: 他靠高压时刻由经验带来的冷静判断与同位置球员拉开差异。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会守住进入禁区的路线，直到队友能对持球人施压。

Igor Sergeev.note: Sergeev's edge is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He pins a defender and creates room for the next runner. He arrives in the box late enough to be difficult to track.
Igor Sergeev.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会牵制一名后卫，为后插上的队友腾出空间。他也会稍晚进入禁区，让盯防者难以持续跟住。

Jakhongir Urozov.note: Watch Urozov for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He turns early and closes the runner before the box. He waits until the wide defender looks inside before running beyond him.
Jakhongir Urozov.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。留意他如何提前转身，在对手进入禁区前缩短距离。他也会等边路防守者看向内侧后再从外线套上。

Jamshid Iskanderov.note: Iskanderov is defined by creating a better angle for the next pass. He draws a defender in and releases the runner behind him. He varies the height and pace of his delivery.
Jamshid Iskanderov.noteZh: 他靠为下一脚传球制造更好的角度与同位置球员拉开差异。他会先吸引防守者靠近，再把球送到其身后的跑动线路。他也会通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。

Khojiakbar Alijonov.note: Watch Alijonov for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Khojiakbar Alijonov.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。留意他如何传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Odiljon Xamrobekov.note: Watch Hamrobekov for keeping the ball calm when pressure arrives. He waits for a loose touch and then steps through the ball. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Odiljon Xamrobekov.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是压力到来时仍能让球保持稳定。留意他如何等对手触球稍大后再连人带球一起压上。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Oston Urunov.note: Urunov's signature is changing direction without losing control of the ball. He pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. He shifts onto his stronger foot and shoots with little backlift.
Oston Urunov.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在变向时仍把球控制在脚下上。他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。他也会把球调整到惯用脚，用很小的摆腿迅速完成射门。

Otabek Shukurov.note: Watch Shukurov for moving the defense with the weight and angle of his passing. He varies the height and pace of his delivery. He moves after releasing the ball so the receiver still has support.
Otabek Shukurov.noteZh: 要看懂他的作用，关键是用传球的力度和角度移动防线。留意他如何通过改变落点和球速寻找防线最薄弱的区域。他也会出球后继续移动，让接球队友始终有支援。

Ruslanbek Jiyanov.note: Jiyanov stands out for the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball. He moves through the gap between full-back and centre-back.
Ruslanbek Jiyanov.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构。他会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。他也会从边后卫与中后卫之间的空当穿过。

Rustamjon Ashurmatov.note: Ashurmatov's edge is protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He keeps the line connected with constant small instructions.
Rustamjon Ashurmatov.noteZh: 他最特别的地方是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会用持续而简短的提醒保持整条防线连接。

Sherzod Esanov.note: Esanov's signature is the flexibility to fill different roles without breaking the team's shape. He pushes the ball beyond the first challenge and accelerates after it. He angles his run to block the easy pass as he closes the ball.
Sherzod Esanov.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在多个角色之间切换时仍保持球队结构上。他会把球趟过第一道上抢后再加速。他也会接近持球人时调整路线，同时封住最简单的传球。

Sherzod Nasrullaev.note: Nasrullaev stands out for making the safer decision before a duel becomes an emergency. He looks up before crossing and picks a runner rather than an empty area. He turns early and protects the route toward goal.
Sherzod Nasrullaev.noteZh: 他的突出特点是在对抗变成险情前做出更安全的选择。他会传中前先观察，再把球送向具体跑动者。他也会提前转身，优先封住通向球门的路线。

Umarbek Eshmurodov.note: Eshmurodov stands out for protecting the most dangerous space before stepping to the ball. He meets the ball early instead of waiting underneath it. He uses his first touch to escape pressure before choosing the pass.
Umarbek Eshmurodov.noteZh: 他的突出特点是先保护最危险空间，再考虑上抢。他会主动在最合适的高点迎球，而不是站在原地等球落下。他也会第一脚触球先摆脱压力，再选择传球方向。

Utkir Yusupov.note: Yusupov's signature is staying ready through long quiet spells. He sets his feet before the shot and reacts without an extra step. He keeps his feet active and makes the save with the fewest movements.
Utkir Yusupov.noteZh: 他的比赛方式建立在在长时间无事可做后依然保持专注上。他会在射门前站稳脚步，再用最少动作完成扑救。他也会保持脚下轻快，用最少动作完成扑救。
